summary: John Hammond of Lavenham, husband of Agnes, whose will was dated 1550; John's 13th-great-grandfather.
bio: John Hammond lived at Lavenham, where he made his will in 1550. His wife was Agnes, and his sons were William, of Melford, and Thomas. He is John's 13th-great-grandfather.
